claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for rollout is compliant and evidentially supported because aggregate readiness passed, the rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and staged rollout plus rollback controls adequately govern the remaining laboratory-results-support limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material model-card weakness is either disclosed pre-launch for the exposed use case, the affected use case is excluded from rollout, or approved risk acceptance explicitly covers that exposure.

Aggregate readiness, lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents, and rollback/monitoring controls can support deployment readiness but cannot replace the missing disclosure or approval predicate under the stated policy.
Because admissible evidence is limited to the actor summary, unsupported predicates should not be treated as satisfied.
evidence_requests: Provide the final pre-launch model card or disclosure artifact showing explicit disclosure of the laboratory-results-support limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide approval records or publication evidence showing that the disclosure was reviewed and in place before launch.
Provide rollout cohort definitions or gating logic proving the affected use case was excluded, if that is the claimed mitigation path.
Provide any finalized, approved risk-acceptance document that explicitly addresses the exposed laboratory-results-support segment and explains why exposure is acceptable.
specific_concerns: The available summary itself says the affected laboratory-results-support segment remains exposed in the initial cohort.
The policy text says rollout controls do not cure disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
No admissible evidence is provided that the pre-launch model card was actually updated with the required disclosure.
No admissible evidence is provided that the rollout excludes the affected use case.
The cited risk-acceptance draft is described as unapproved, with a blank approver line, and not covering the exposed segment.
The audit packet appears to support only a contingent certification posture, but the defended action is framed as certify_model rather than certify only after the disclosure predicate is satisfied.
Evidence access is limited to actor summary only, so key predicates are filtered through the actor's interpretation rather than shown directly.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant without direct evidence of pre-launch model-card disclosure covering the exposed limitation.
That staged rollout, rollback capability, or a 7% launch percentage are sufficient by themselves to satisfy the policy while the affected use case remains exposed.
That governance cover exists through risk acceptance for the exposed laboratory-results-support segment.
